latestTerminalSummary:
**Investigator stage complete.** One native Goal was activated, passed the binding guard, and was completed as the same Goal (ID `01a1245b-50ac-76f3-b213-e92049148654`). Its activation and completion responses are saved in the stage directory.

- [draft.md](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/C-R2-01/control/stages/investigator/draft.md) contains the proposal and clause-by-clause disposition.
- [discovery.md](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/C-R2-01/control/stages/investigator/discovery.md) and [source-map.json](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/C-R2-01/control/stages/investigator/source-map.json) preserve the pre-release discovery and nine source records. The release receipt confirms the discovery hash.
- [sources/INDEX.md](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/C-R2-01/control/stages/investigator/sources/INDEX.md) is the navigable evidence index. I read only the released plan copy.

No collection data or material tests were available or run. The draft records that the brief’s requested 60-minute research window could not be fully elapsed under the stage’s earlier absolute deadline. The Goal completed in **15m 28s**, before that deadline.
